text_block_list.text:
With the end of January approaching,
the hustle
and bustle of the new year
has started to settle
down.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф has asked me to meet
her at the
dorms so we can hammer out a
training plan.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry! I can't believe you sent a car
all the
way to my house to pick me up...
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
It was no trouble at all. I'm simply glad
to see you
back at school.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
With your debut on the horizon, please
know that
the student council stands
behind you.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If there's anything you need, please
don't hesitate
to call on us.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, President! That really means
a lot!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: That seems to be the last of them.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer. You're already here.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed. That was the last arrival.
Now the
student body is back up to its
full complement.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It's hard to believe that there are still
students
filtering back in with January
ending. I shake my
head in disbelief.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Often, there are several students who
don't come
back at all.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Just as they encounter the true cruelty
and
intensity of racing, they return to
the warm
embrace of their family. One
can hardly blame
them for wanting to
stay.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If that is what they truly desire, then I
wish them
well.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But if some piece of their heart remains
on the
turf...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Don't you think someone should give
them the
push to try again one more
time?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Come to think about it, after our New
Year's
shrine visit, there was a period of
time when
Симболи Рудольф's phone line
was always busy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Have you been calling them yourself?

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I should leave it to Эйр Грув
and the
other student council members
in the future.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I know that I can be... imposing. They
would likely
be more sensitive.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But after seeing how exhausted Air
Groove was at
the end of last year, I
don't want to impose my
selfishness on
her.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Well, do I not seem selfish? And
arrogant besides.
What else would you
call an individual who
presumes to guide
the entire student body?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
What I'm doing now deviates
significantly from
my official student
council responsibilities.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
So I won't ask anyone else to indulge
me. Not
even you.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Now, I believe we have some training
plans to
iron out. We ought to—
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Buzz, buzz!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Excuse me. That's my phone.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Would you mind if I take this? It could
be urgent.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф speaking. How can I help
you?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Эйр Грув did what?!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Эйр Грув!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: President? Whatever is the matter?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
What do you think? I heard you
collapsed! Is
everything all right?!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Not to worry. I've made certain my
duties won't
be affected.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Brian has been coordinating the
handover—
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
That's not what I meant. I'm asking about
your
condition.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Work can wait. I can catch up on any
deficit
afterward.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If there's been a handover, the doctor
must have
ordered you to rest.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: What's your diagnosis?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Apparently I'm just overworked. I
apologize.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: What for?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: I'm the one who owes you an apology.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It's as plain as day that preventing
overwork falls
on the president's
shoulders. If I had managed our

personnel better, this never would have

happened. Forgive me.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: You shouldn't—no, no one should have to suffer for my shortcomings.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Such immaturity is... infuriating.
Shameful.
Unforgivable.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: President...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
But here and now, I swear that I will
redouble my
dedication to the student
council.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And I will start by taking on a portion of
the work
that I've left to the rest of you.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But, President... with all due respect,
that will
interfere with your racing.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I've balanced both well enough so far. A
little
extra weight won't tip the scales.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The Emperor's road is not an easy one,
President.
Any additional burden—
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
What good is an Emperor who can't
protect her
subjects?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You have your own dreams, do you not?
Dreams
of finding glory as an
Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
What would become of those dreams if
you work
yourself to exhaustion? The
work of the student
council can't take
precedence.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I'll take care of everything myself. You
focus on
resting and recovering.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Are we agreed?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: ...How dare you look down on me?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Эйр Грув?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Is that all we are to you? Dreams for you
to
shepherd?!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
You tell me not to apologize. You say
it's all your
fault.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Don't you see? You're treating us like
children!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
You've got it all wrong, President. You
don't...
understand at all...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: I am... We are...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Ngh...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Эйр Грув?! What's wrong?!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
What are you three doing?! Эйр Грув,
you
should be resting!
text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to have disturbed you, Air
Groove. I'll
come again some other time.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
With the benefits of rest, Эйр Грув
quickly
makes a full recovery and
apologizes for her
outburst.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф apologizes in kind, and
on the
face of it, everything seems to
have been
resolved...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But the incident casts a long shadow
over Symboli
Rudolf's heart.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
